index.copy:
Isihumusho Semibhalo Engezansi Se-AI Samahhala

Leli ithuluzi lokuhumusha imibhalo engezansi lamahhala ku-inthanethi elinikwa amandla amamodeli ezilimi ezinkulu. Layisha amafayela e-SRT, VTT noma ASS bese uhumusha phakathi kwesiNgisi, isiShayina, isiJapane, isiKhoriya, iSpanishi, isiFulentshi nezinye izilimi ezingaphezu kwe-15+. Akukho ukubhalisa, akukho ukufaka, akukho phawu lwamanzi.

Izici ezibalulekile: Ukuhlaziya nokuhumusha kwe-AI kwe-SRT, VTT ne-ASS, ukuhlanganiswa kwemisho ehlakaniphile, ukuvumelanisa kwesikhathi, ukugoqwa kwemigqa okuzenzakalelayo, ukususwa kwamagama agcwalisayo, nokuphathwa kwamagama angokwezifiso. Thumela amafayela ajwayelekile e-SRT, VTT, ASS noma TXT alungele ividiyo yakho.

Okwenzelwe bona: abahumushi bama-video, abadali be-YouTube nabasebenzi bendawo, abafundi bezilimi, namaqembu adinga ukwenza kusebenze okuqukethwe kwevidiyo ngokushesha.
